title: Polyautography
summary: POLYAUTOG'RAPHY, noun [Gr. many, he himself, and to write.] The act or practice of multiplying copies of one's own handwriting or of manuscripts, by engraving on stone; a species of lithography.

inlines.v: POLYAUTOG'RAPHY, noun [Gr. many, he himself, and to write.] The act or practice of multiplying copies of one's own handwriting or of manuscripts, by engraving on stone; a species of lithography.
